$comment: RAY-CLOUD shared contract 1.0.0-draft.2. Every platform table mapped to a snapshot data category.

categories.meaning: Organizations, users and memberships. Exactly one organization in v1.
Live credential state that the identity policy resets.
Idempotency replay state bound to reset credentials.
Agent and workflow run records; runHistoryPolicy chooses included or excluded.
Authentication audit log of the source environment.
Tenant event bus streams and events; application data that consumers read by cursor.
Migration ledgers that define the schema head.
Fence, environment revision and apply receipts of the source runtime; the target starts its own.
Every table generated from the spec stores.
The whole workflow system database as a second dump.
Every blob, as logical bytes plus the stored file.

rules: Excluded tables are dumped with their schema and without rows (pg_dump --exclude-table-data), so the target reaches the same schema head with those tables empty.

excludedDataCategories in snapshot.json lists every category whose rows were not exported: always credential-state, request-replay-state, security-audit-log and runtime-control-state, plus run-history when runHistoryPolicy is excluded.

Every product store table is product-store-data. A table in the application database that is neither listed here nor a product store of the embedded application blocks export with RAY_EXTERNAL_STATE_UNSUPPORTED reason unknown-table.
A platform migration that adds a table must add its row here in the same change; the export refuses an unmapped platform table.

The workflow system database is the database the source resolves from DBOS_SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL, or else <appdb>_dbos_sys derived from DATABASE_URL; the source resolves that name unconditionally (packages/app/server/src/composition-root.ts:1101-1105), but the database exists only once the durable executor has launched, which happens only when the deployment wires the durable worker (deployment.durableWorker true and agent backends supplied, composition-root.ts:2769). Export checks pg_database on that server under the fence: when the database exists it is dumped whole to payload/workflow-system.dump and snapshot.json says workflowSystemDatabase included; when it does not exist, snapshot.json says absent and carries no second dump.

tables.note: key_hash is an HMAC under the pepper (packages/kernel/db/src/schema.ts, api_keys docblock); a reissued pepper invalidates every row.
The source environment security log stays with the source; not an unbounded log dump into the target.
Replay snapshots bound to credentials that are reset; they never carry key plaintext (packages/compose/api-auth/src/routes/orgs.ts:368-370).
token_hash is an HMAC under the pepper (packages/kernel/auth-core/src/invite.ts:28-31); a reissued pepper invalidates every row.
OAuth grants, codes and tokens of the source issuer; meaningless under a reissued signing key.
token_hash is an HMAC under the API-key pepper (packages/kernel/auth-core/src/session.ts:23-27); a reissued pepper invalidates every row.
argon2id password hashes stay inside the encrypted snapshot; preserved only through the audited identity adapter (packages/kernel/auth-core/src/password.ts:14-27).
Excluding run history does not remove workflow inputs and outputs held in the workflow system database, which is always included.

workflowSystemDatabase.policy: included whole when the database exists at capture time
